subject.title: feat(openrouter): forward OpenClaw session id as session_id

question: Should OpenClaw support an opt-in OpenRouter-plugin setting that emits a stable, OpenRouter-scoped session correlation identifier for sticky routing and observability?
rationale: Hashing avoids sending the raw internal identifier, but enabling the option still deliberately establishes a stable third-party correlation value and a durable provider configuration contract.

options.title: Sponsor plugin-local opt-in
options.body: Accept the default-off OpenRouter setting, retain the derived identifier design, and require current-head live proof plus privacy-focused documentation before merge.

options.title: Keep session metadata caller-controlled
options.body: Decline a built-in plugin setting and leave `session_id` to explicit caller-provided OpenRouter request parameters or future generic provider metadata work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor plugin-local opt-in
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off OpenRouter setting, retain the derived identifier design, and require current-head live proof plus privacy-focused documentation before merge.
